name: Big River Internet
summary: Grafton NSW regional ISP (bri.net.au live by Jan 1998; BRI); in the Nornet/Linear G group from ~2001; brand folded into LinearG Dec 2018.

events.details: Grafton NSW regional dialup/ISP; bri.net.au live by 11 Jan 1998 (earliest Wayback capture).
Nornet's site states the Modulux/Nornet group had Big River Internet under its umbrella 'since 2001'; bri.net.au kept operating under the Big River Internet brand until Dec 2018.

refs.label: Nornet (Wayback 25 Jul 2013): 'Since 2001, Modulux pty ltd have under its umbrella ... Grafton's BRI (Big River Internet)'

events.details: Brand folded into Linear G; bri.net.au first archived redirecting to linearg.com 27 Dec 2018.

refs.label: LinearG homepage: lists Big River Internet among the ISPs incorporated
